ownership.futureControlAndCapture: Existing RR2 execution owner, after ownership and separate approval are recorded

destination.coordinateRule: Never substitute process target, player position or synthetic coordinates for a game entity or ground destination. Actual input must match the reviewed location without unrecorded repositioning.

cancellation.pulsePolicy: Proposed duration within the historical 20-250 ms transport contract; current binding, reviewed clearance and actual execution contract must be verified first.
cancellation.takeoverAfterUncertainty: Use the explicitly approved operator recovery plan. STOP/key-up may release injected input but is not proof that native C2M stopped. Do not replay activation.

observation.source: Qualified current player reference samples through the existing RR2 observation path; saved October 19 receipt is example shape only.
observation.clockAlignment: Common guest monotonic time domain or a verified conservative interval mapping; never subtract unrelated host/guest clocks as exact latency.
observation.thresholdQualification: These are proposed observation-policy bounds, not measured RIFT timing/units. Freeze them against a current stationary baseline before activation; missing tolerance or inadequate sampling blocks interpretation. Do not tune after seeing the outcome.

blockers.need: Identity-bound current C2M enable/gesture and backward-action binding evidence; the old Q/E prose conflict remains unresolved.

Reviewed coordinate-bound single ground request or equivalent explicitly approved physical-action recording; inspected camera-action schema is not this contract. Preserve existing unfinished dispatch work.
Advancing baseline/during/post-cancel samples with acquisition timing, current identity/scene, measured noise/tolerance and immediate before/after/settled images.
Separate live approval, exclusive actual control ownership and reviewed operator takeover; do not infer these from this document or offline queue tests.

handoffAcceptance: All four blockers have actual evidence dispositions, not fabricated booleans or old fresh flags.
Any proposed RR2 change has an explicit sole owner and current source baseline; RRE does not edit the other owner's unfinished files.
M4A source/fixtures stay intact; physical-stop analysis continues independently after intention cancellation.
T1 still waits for actual T0 pass; T2 still waits for T1. Native route research is not a type-7 dependency.
A native detour may initially increase goal distance. Do not treat M4A moving-away as proof of route failure.
One passing T0 establishes only this scene/mode/session behavior, not general routing, another mode's cancellation or restart survival.
parkAndReopenRule: Park after two distinct probes without decision-changing evidence, immediately on an access/authorization block; reopen only with a new observation, qualified source/contract or resolution of that exact blocker.
